findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_availability, get_quote, get_property, request_booking · Private data: search_availability, cancel_booking · Public sink: search_availability, get_quote, get_property, request_booking, cancel_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_availability, get_quote, get_property, request_booking · Private data: search_availability, cancel_booking · Public sink: search_availability, get_quote, get_property, request_booking, cancel_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
